offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费；每次搜索从固定 10000 tokens 起
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens. Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC), Free.
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其 URL 和内容，转换为适合 LLM 的干净文本；JSON 模式返回五项列表
offerings.note: 端点 https://s.jina.ai；免费/付费 Key 100 RPM，Premium Key 1000 RPM；平均延迟 2.5 秒。
